other_conditions: Girl students eligible for classes 1‑5; both boys and girls eligible for classes 6‑10.
One‑time failure in a class is allowed.
No need to reapply for renewal within the same level (Class 1‑10).
benefits_summary: Scholarship amounts range from ₹250 to ₹1,200 per year depending on class and gender, deposited directly into the student's bank account.
